name: Chicago Fabrications
old_description: Chicago Fabrications is a well-established design and build company known for its efficiency, craftsmanship, and innovation. Since 2012, we have advanced the industry through refined wood joinery, metal welding, and structural fabrication. Our work includes multi-million-dollar collaborations with Synergy Construction Group, Amazon Prime, Star Wars, Norweta Apartments, Assemble, Goose Island Brewery Event Center, and numerous restaurant and retail millwork projects. Our clientele ranges from homeowners and design teams to condo associations seeking custom furniture and millwork within specific budgets.
about:
Chicago Fabrications was founded in 2012 in Chicago, Illinois. The company began as a design and build firm focused on refined wood joinery, metal welding, and structural fabrication.

The company operates as a full-service design and fabrication shop, producing custom environments and brand experiences from concept to completion. Its capabilities span brand activations, trade show exhibits, retail displays, pop-up builds, custom furniture and fixtures, event builds, interior renovations, scenic elements, and specialty fabrication. Work is executed in-house, combining wood joinery, metal welding, and structural fabrication, with design, production, logistics, and installation managed under one roof.

Chicago Fabrications serves brands, agencies, and design teams across technology, sports, entertainment, fashion, food and beverage, construction, and residential sectors. Notable projects include activations for Barstool Sports, Amazon, Nike, Disney’s Star Wars, Netflix, LIV Golf, Burberry, Jordan, and Square, as well as millwork for Goose Island Brewery Event Center and Norweta Apartments. The clientele also includes homeowners, design teams, and condo associations seeking custom furniture and millwork.

The company emphasizes an integrated approach, handling design, production, logistics, and installation internally to maintain control over quality and timeline. It highlights its craftsmanship in wood and metal fabrication and its ability to deliver nationwide from its Chicago facility.
